title: Candidate Registry Entry
description: One candidate registry row for a strategy hypothesis or reserved candidate slot.

name.description: Human-readable candidate name from the hypothesis title or reserved slot.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the candidate.

overall_verdict.description: Decision outcome when available; PENDING for drafts and reserved slots.

strategy_family.description: Conservative normalized family label derived from the hypothesis title and rationale.

timeframe.description: Primary timeframe declared by the candidate, or reserved timeframe for a slot.

information_inputs.description: Normalized information streams used by the candidate. Reserved slots may be empty.

free_parameter_count.description: Number of free parameters when declared; null for reserved slots or incomplete repo truth.

hypothesis_md_path.description: Path to the candidate HYPOTHESIS.md file, or null for a reserved slot.

decision_record_path.description: Path to the decision record, or null before a decision exists.

trial_ids.description: Trial-log IDs associated with this candidate.

pipeline_stage.description: Current stage in the research pipeline. Reserved does not imply pre-registration.

created_at.description: ISO date when the candidate or reserved slot was created.

updated_at.description: ISO date of the latest registry-relevant update.

direction_profile.description: Optional directional profile when cleanly derivable.

notes.description: Short human note about repo-truth limitations or slot status.

differentiation_summary.description: One-line summary of what makes the candidate distinct.
